missing: GENIUS Act stablecoin final-rules deadline is July 18, 2026 — TOMORROW: six agencies (OCC, FDIC, NCUA, Treasury, FinCEN, OFAC) must finalize rules one year after enactment; comment periods closed June 9 and there is no statutory fallback if they miss. Direct near-term catalyst/risk for stablecoins (USDC/Coinbase economics — which the findings themselves cite in the CLARITY yield fight — and Tether) yet absent from all three crypto findings. (Kraken blog Jul 15, CryptoSlate, OCC Bulletin 2026-3, Chapman tracker.)

US Q2 earnings season is underway and clusters against the July FOMC: JPMorgan/BofA/Citi/Wells reported July 14-15 (same day as CPI); Alphabet July 22; Microsoft and Meta July 29 — the same day as the Fed decision; Apple and Amazon July 30; ~$725B of planned 2026 hyperscaler AI capex is the dominant theme. The findings cite 'AI-spending worries' as a crypto risk-off driver but omit the entire US earnings calendar that will set global risk sentiment during the plan's first two weeks. (VaaSBlock, IG, ClaritX previews.)

OPEC+ supply policy is absent from the UAE macro work: the July 5 virtual meeting approved a fifth consecutive monthly output increase (+188K b/d for August across Saudi/Russia/Iraq/Kuwait/Kazakhstan/Algeria/Oman), and the next meeting is August 2 — directly material to Brent (which the findings track closely), UAE fiscal backdrop, and ADX energy names. CNBC notes the hike came 'as Hormuz exports start to recover,' a nuance that cuts against the pure supply-fear narrative. (CNBC Jul 5, Bloomberg, Rigzone.)

Fed HIKE risk is materially understated: post-June-SEP, the median 2026 dot was revised UP to 3.8% (from 3.4%), nine of eighteen members project at least one hike, and CNBC's June-CPI coverage says the Fed is 'broadly expected to raise its benchmark rate in September.' The findings frame July 28-29 almost entirely as hold-vs-cut; a hike-skewed Fed is a different regime for crypto beta and for dirham-pegged UAE funding costs. (CNBC Jul 14, Intellectia, NPR Jun 17.)

Iran succession is resolved, not open: Ali Khamenei was assassinated February 28, 2026 and Mojtaba Khamenei was announced as supreme leader on March 9 after an Assembly of Experts vote — important context for regime durability and war trajectory that the UAE findings present as unresolved 'succession uncertainty.' (Wikipedia, CNN, Washington Post, Carnegie.)

CLARITY Act floor-vote development: Senate Majority Leader Thune has pledged a floor vote before the August recess, with the week of July 20 under active discussion — a nearer and harder catalyst than the findings' 'no floor vote scheduled' framing. (Coinpedia, KuCoin/Lummis, PYMNTS.)
